title: platform-standup-2026-03-29
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Leah, Omar, Priya

Quick notes / decisions:
- Proceed with config-store v2 canary today (10% traffic) for control-plane routes. If no regression/error-rate increase after 2h, bump to 50% and schedule full cutover tomorrow morning. See PLAT-4321 for rollout plan and rollback steps.
- Routing team to enable regional-fallback policy for EU->US on non-sensitive traffic; keep sensitive routes pinned to EU only.
- Short-term quotas patch (race fix for Redis counters) merged to main, will be deployed to staging tonight. If green, promote to prod after 0400 UTC window.

Yesterday:
- Control plane (Aisha + Marcus): finalised schema migration for config-store v2; wrote migration job + dry-run. Ran dry-run against canary account set — no diffs in effective routing policies. Working on telemetry to show per-route deltas.
- Routing (Marcus): end-to-end test for sticky routing failing intermittently; traced to session-affinity token expiry mismatch between LB and control plane. Created PR #256 to add grace window and unit tests.
- Auth (Leah): token introspection throughput improved after batching change but saw 5% regression in 99th latencies due to GC spikes on the auth service. Investigating memory pinning and GC tuning.
- Quotas (Omar): reproduced counter increment duplication under high concurrent increments; identified race between local batching and Redis pipeline flush. Implemented mutex in local flush path — tests show reduced duplication.

Today / Next 24h:
- Control plane: start canary (10%) at 08:30 PST; monitoring dashboard (control-plane/canary) to be observed by Aisha and Priya. Action: if error-rate >= 0.5% or latency p50 increases > 20ms, rollback immediately.
- Routing: deploy sticky-session fix to staging, run full infra e2e. If green, schedule prod rollout during the non-peak window (02:00–04:00 UTC). Marcus to coordinate with SRE.
- Auth: Leah to experiment with G1GC flags and heap sizing on staging; target 99th latency improvement of 15%. Will open follow-up ticket for runtime tuning.
- Quotas: Omar to run load test with >10k concurrent increments and validate counters over 1h. If stable, merge the patch to release branch and include in nightly deploy.

Blockers / Risks:
- Config-store migration: one customer has custom plugin that writes non-conforming metadata. Need to either patch migration to tolerate or reach out to customer. Aisha to own communication (PLAT-4330).
- Routing sticky-session bug causes occasional incorrect route selection for long-lived sessions (reported in PLAT-4318). Risk to a small set of customers during rollout. Plan: canary + close monitoring + quick rollback.
- Quotas race could still show edge-case duplication under multi-region failover. Need SRE to run chaos tests simulating Redis failover. Omar to setup chaos job (ticket: PLAT-4342).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should quota counter persistence be migrated from Redis to the new time-series counter store in Q2? Pros/cons doc needed — assign to product/infra to evaluate.
- What SLAs do we expose for regional-fallback behaviors in case of cross-region latency? Product to draft guidance.

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: start canary + owner of migration communication (PLAT-4330).
- Marcus: coordinate routing sticky-session staging run + PR #256.
- Leah: auth GC tuning experiments + open follow-up ticket with results.
- Omar: run quota load tests, setup chaos failover test (PLAT-4342).
- Priya: update canary dashboard with alert thresholds and add automation for rollback if alert fires.

Misc / notes to self:
- Reminder: update runbook with the new config-store rollback command (configctl rollback --version).
- Ping legal for quick review if migration touches any customer-managed metadata.
- Follow-up sync Friday 10:00 PT to review canary metrics and decide on full cutover.

Links / references: PLAT-4321 (config-store migration), PLAT-4318 (sticky-session bug), PLAT-4342 (quota chaos testing), PR #256 (routing fix), Confluence: Control Plane design page.

Rough health summary: control plane — green (canary pending), routing — amber (sticky-session flaky), auth — amber (99p regression investigation), quotas — amber->green on staging after patch.

Notes formatted quickly — keeping this as working doc. Will update after canary and staging runs.
